Class StoragePolicy

java.lang.Object
ecmwf.ecpds.master.storage.StoragePolicy
public final class StoragePolicy extends Object
A Storage Lifecycle Policy. A policy can only shorten the physical retention of a data file, never extend it beyond the lifetime (expiry) of the related transfers.

    • select

      public static StoragePolicy.Match select(List<StoragePolicy> policies, StoragePolicy.Subject subject)
      Selects the policy for the subject. A policy explicitly named by the destination option always wins. Otherwise the active, non-disabled policies are examined in order and the first one whose criteria all match is selected. If none matches the built-in default policy is returned.
      Parameters:
      policies - the policies (any order)
      subject - the subject
      Returns:
      the match

    • matches

      public boolean matches(StoragePolicy.Subject subject)

      Parameters:

      Returns:
      true, if all the criteria match

    • guaranteedUntil

      public long guaranteedUntil(long windowStart, long expiry)
      Gets the time until which the original file is guaranteed to be kept for a requeue. A policy can only shorten the retention, never extend it beyond the lifetime.
      Parameters:
      windowStart - the start of the window (time of the last activity)
      expiry - the expiry time of the transfer (the lifetime)
      Returns:
      the time until which the requeue is guaranteed
